profiles.summary: Lead L-1262 was answered from mined data. In all 237 blocks of the PoolManager's history in which two or more transactions touch it (668 PoolManager transactions), the 1,864 receipts that the official endpoint serves equal the archive replica's in status, gas used and every log, and the block hash and receipts root are equal. The replicas recompute the receipts root under per-transaction transient storage and refuse a block that does not match the producer's header, so the producer's results in those blocks are those of an execution that resets transient storage between transactions.

deltas.delta: eth_getBlockReceipts on the official endpoint omits system transactions: in the 237 blocks the archive replica serves 113 more receipts, all with gas price 0 and all from system senders (0x2000...0000 and token system addresses 0x2000...XXXX, 0x2222...2222, the USDC contract 0x6b9e...0a24 and 0xc206...3c00). None carries a PoolManager log.

cleared.check: L-1262: in the 237 blocks with two or more PoolManager transactions (blocks 47,069,954 to 52,388,737), are the producer's receipts those of an execution that resets transient storage between transactions?
cleared.result: Yes. 1,864 of 1,864 receipts served by the official endpoint equal the replica's in status, gas used and logs, and the 237 block hashes and receipts roots are equal. Only 3 PoolManager transactions in those blocks emitted no PoolManager log (blocks 49,161,462, 49,161,463 and 49,161,550); in each the PoolManager frames (unlock, swap, mint, settle) succeeded and the transaction reverted above them, and each was the last PoolManager transaction of its block, so no later transaction could have met a leaked unlock flag or delta.

leads.question: When a mined HyperEVM block first holds a PoolManager transaction that fails or reverts above a completed unlock and is followed by another PoolManager transaction in the same block, does the later transaction's receipt on the official endpoint equal the replica's?
leads.why: In the whole history so far each such transaction was the last PoolManager transaction of its block, so the direct form of the transient reset test has no instance; receipts root agreement covers it only indirectly.

leadResults.answer: Operator level, recorded for reference. No public info query lists treasury addresses: spotMeta (522 tokens) has fields name, szDecimals, weiDecimals, index, tokenId, isCanonical, evmContract, fullName, deployerTradingFeeShare and deployerLabel only, tokenDetails for USDC names no treasury, and alignedQuoteTokenInfo with or without a token returns HTTP 422. The aligned quote assets page is byte equal to cycle 32. The PoolManager has no HyperCore account (userRole returns missing, spot balances empty) and its nonce is 1, so no transfer in its name has happened.

On HyperEVM: across all 237 blocks with two or more PoolManager transactions, the official endpoint's 1,864 receipts equal the replica's in status, gas and logs, with equal block hashes and receipts roots, and the replica refuses blocks whose recomputed receipts root differs from the producer's. The 3 PoolManager transactions without a PoolManager log reverted above completed PoolManager frames and were each the last PoolManager transaction of their block. Arc (5042) was not in this unit.

No new information. The announcements channel has no post after 2026-11-20 naming a build or rule, hl-node is still HTTP 403, hl-visor is byte equal, nanoreth master Cargo.lock is byte equal to cycle 32 and no newer tag exists. The rerun battery, targeted set and both script sets give the cycle 32 results on the official node, so no execution rule visible through eth_call moved.
